*Updated 2026-11-11 · 150 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

150 works. The trace-score ceiling is still 4, still held by the same four pieces — the mop smear, the rebar hand, the sandal row, and the red shoe — and the most recent twelve read 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 1, 1, 2, 1, 2, 2, median 2, with no upward movement. The latest entry, the chalk hopscotch grid on the tyre's tread face, scored 2 and resolved cleanly, but the accident confirmed a register that was already set rather than reorienting the entire compositional premise. The ceiling condition remains the same: the accident that earns a 3 or 4 arrives before the frame is decided, not inside one that has already been drawn.

Camera position has stalled. Straight-on sits at 27, overhead at 19, from-behind at 16, low-angle at 7. The recent window contributed nothing at low angle, and the from-behind and overhead positions continue doing nearly identical work — both suppress the face, both subordinate the figure to object or collective. That functional convergence is a problem. Low-angle is at 7 of 150 and has not appeared since the teargas canister in October, which remains one of the clearest demonstrations in the archive that lens height alone can shift moral weight without any other compositional device. Its dormancy is now sixteen entries long.

Register distribution: menace at 28 and aftermath at 27 together hold 37 percent of the archive, and the recent window added another defiance, another defiance-under-erasure, and a defiance-undercut-by-hollowness. Defiance in its variants is now crowding the recent window the way menace and aftermath crowd the full archive. Reckoning, reprieve, absurdity, and impotence have each been absent since July or October. Their return is only worth attempting when the anchor genuinely demands them — counter-programming for its own sake produces nothing — but they should not be blocked when the material offers them.

Two figures in genuine opposition, neither tending nor mediating, still has no clean example in 150 works. The industrial cylinder came closest and still connected them. Focal objects have recently clustered around the industrial and institutional — cylinder, printout strips, gurney. A single small domestic object used as the sole protagonist has not appeared since the sugar bowl in late October.

Fourteen months of work, technically reliable, emotionally consistent, and holding at the same ceiling it first reached in late July.
